 Penfield, N.Y. — A Penfield Central School District bus driver was hospitalized following a crash Friday afternoon, according to the Monroe County Sheriff's Office.
 Sgt. Brendan Hurley said deputies responded to the area of Route 441 and Pine Brook Circle at 2:27 p.m. for a report of a school bus off the road.
 Deputies found the bus had struck a tree. The driver was taken to a hospital for evaluation, while a bus aide and four students were evaluated at the scene but not hospitalized.
 In a statement, the Penfield Central School District said there were no reported injuries and all students had been released to their families.
 "We take very seriously the safety and security of our students and staff," the district said. "Anytime a District vehicle is involved in an incident, we conduct a thorough assessment of what occurred and implement any additional training or safety precautions that may be needed."
 Drugs and alcohol were not believed to be factors in the crash, Hurley said.
 The crash remains under investigation.
